Some of the routes that Google Maps and the councils show as cycle routes are hard or impossible to cycle: a path that turns into a stony beach, or a walled lane too narrow for two bikes to pass. Each one breaks a route that is otherwise good, and pushes people back onto busy roads or off their bikes.

This project documents those gaps, one at a time, with photos taken on the ground, what the map claims, and what the council has said or planned. Each page ends with questions for Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council (DLR). Pages are updated when there's news.

:::{#pieces}
